title: Financial product idea seed
description: The financial product ideas Mynt ships (workspaces/coding-build/templates/product-ideas.seed.json): ideas for new products a licensed firm could define, offered in the Build page's Financial product mode. They live in Postgres (financial_products.product_ideas) once an admin runs seed_product_ideas, which adds the missing ones and never overwrites a row already there. src/product-ideas.ts checks what this schema can't say: the region, product line and category have products Mynt runs there, and the text promises, projects and advises nothing.
